title: Rams place Puka Nacua on IR after all. Where does LA go from here?

sources.title: Rams place Puka Nacua on IR after all. Where does LA go from here?
sources.description: The Rams are pivoting one day after head coach Sean McVay told reporters that Puka Nacua wouldn't go on IR due to "roster semantics."
